conjecture: The UNIFIED cyclic H^2 engine: for a finite cyclic group C_n = Z/n acting TRIVIALLY on the module M = Z/m, degree-2 group cohomology is H^2(C_n; Z/m) = coker(.n on Z/m) = Z / gcd(n,m). This is ONE parametrised fact that subsumes both existing H^2-cluster edge engines: the base-edge engine (cyclic-h2-norm-engine, H^2(C_n;Z)=Z/n) is the modulus-free case m=0 (since Z = Z/0, gcd(n,0)=n), and the fibre-edge engine (fibre-h2-z2-engine, H^2(Z/2;Z/2)=Z/2) is the case n=m=2 (gcd(2,2)=2). The reduction: under the trivial action H^2 is the cokernel of the norm map N=.n on M; with M=Z/mZ, coker(.n on Z/mZ) = (Z/mZ)/((nZ+mZ)/mZ) = Z/(nZ+mZ) = Z/gcd(n,m) by Bezout (nZ+mZ = gcd(n,m)Z). FORMALISED sorry-free in Lean 4 core (Mathlib-free).
